bullets: The desktop app can now look up a specific pull request by repository and number in chat.
You will be asked to confirm before a site publish replaces a live deployment managed by a different conversation.
The size limit for uploading skill packages increased from 3 megabytes to 16 megabytes.
The assistant now shows a limited-access message only when using a VPN or proxy from a full-access country.
Searches for MCP or model context protocol in web settings now direct you to the integrations page.
Ads in the free tier can now display unique images instead of using a shared campaign icon.
A new internal marker for phone apps to request post-task reviews was defined but is not yet active.
Agent discovery now ignores vendor directories to prevent external code from running automatically.
Internal tracking for the streak share feature was updated to record the specific day of last appearance.
A new internal marker for administrative requests was defined but is not yet connected to any live process.
The minimum quality bar for third-party ads was raised to test stricter filtering of poor matches.
New internal math tools were added to plan future user tests and calculate sample sizes.
Internal statistics tools now allow a stricter confidence level for comparing multiple results.
Internal notes were updated to reflect that streak sharing is a standard feature for classic accounts.
Internal code comments were cleaned up to remove outdated references to model limits.
New shared rules were added to compare document versions and restrict remote image links.
